rules: Independent diagnostic and validation seeds; final candidate procedures fixed before evaluation
Known nuisance and known audit arms are diagnostic synthetic information, not deployable inputs
Diagnostic designs share evaluation draws, nested pilot prefixes and audit counts within each date size
Report exact conditional pilot target, bias, empirical SD, mean SE, widths, all-request coverage, conditional coverage, availability and binomial Monte Carlo intervals
Final comparison: inherited independent-pilot Bartlett, joint fixed-dictionary OLS Bartlett, and joint OLS untapered covariance through the response horizon
Finite-horizon covariance requires the stated structural innovation and correct fixed action-mean law; invalid declarations are retained adverse examples
Nonpositive calendar variance and weak-audit rank produce unavailable outcomes; never clip or discard them
No final coverage-based tuning; no claim of uniform calibration from a finite simulation
Workloads include fresh-process imports, identity checks, fit, inference, persistence and read-back; synthetic input acquisition excluded equally
Available-host measurements do not establish target-bank-platform service levels or analyst savings
